attribution.note: Zitron states this forecast in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the forecast of financing need and its horizon. Almost certain expresses high confidence; the separately hedged size estimate is appropriately excluded.

contract.note: The contract appropriately distinguishes needing funding from completing a round. Its end-of-March interpretation does not affect this assessment before March. Company disclosures would remain self-reported evidence.

output.rationale: The March 2027 deadline is after the evaluation date, and the contract provides no early-resolution rule. No outcome evidence items are supplied. The noted funding talks do not establish necessity, and absence of a completed round before the deadline cannot contradict the forecast.
